error.stream_closed: Lost the connection to Umbriel; reconnecting.

show_all_monitors.label: Show all monitors
show_all_monitors.description: Include scratchpad windows from every monitor on this widget. Recommended with several monitors: a hidden scratchpad has no real monitor, so with this off its icons jump between bars as it is shown on different outputs.

active_indicator.label: Active window indicator
active_indicator.description: Show a small dot below the focused window's icon.

indicator_color.label: Active indicator color
indicator_color.description: Color of the dot below the focused window's icon.

active_opacity.label: Active icon opacity
active_opacity.description: Opacity of the focused window's icon.

dim_unfocused.label: Dim unfocused windows
dim_unfocused.description: While a scratchpad window has focus, dim the other icons in its scratchpad.

unfocused_opacity.label: Inactive icon opacity
unfocused_opacity.description: Opacity of the other icons while a scratchpad window has focus.

hidden_opacity.label: Hidden icon opacity
hidden_opacity.description: Opacity of icons while their scratchpad is hidden.

icon_size.label: Icon size
icon_size.description: Size of the app icons, in pixels.

only_shown.label: Only shown scratchpads
only_shown.description: Hide scratchpads that are currently hidden.

group_by_scratchpad.label: Group by scratchpad
group_by_scratchpad.description: Group icons into scratchpad capsules. Turn off for one flat row of icons.

hide_empty.label: Hide empty scratchpads
hide_empty.description: Omit known scratchpads that have no windows.

known_scratchpads.label: Known scratchpads
known_scratchpads.description: Scratchpad names listed first, in this order; shown even when empty if empty scratchpads are not hidden.

hidden_scratchpads.label: Hidden scratchpads
hidden_scratchpads.description: Scratchpad names left out of the bar unless that scratchpad is shown.

group_content.label: Group content
group_content.description: What each scratchpad group shows: app icons, a window count, or dots (up to five, then +N for the rest).

single_icon_per_app.label: Single icon per app
single_icon_per_app.description: Collapse multiple windows from the same app into one icon with a count badge; clicking cycles through them.

group_capsule.label: Scratchpad group capsule
group_capsule.description: Draw the border around each scratchpad group. Turn off to keep grouping and labels only.

hide_when_empty.label: Hide when empty
hide_when_empty.description: Take no bar space when there is nothing to show.

show_label.label: Scratchpad capsule label
show_label.description: Show the small scratchpad name tag on each group; turn off for icon-only groups.

label_placement.label: Label placement
label_placement.description: Top corner, vertically centered on the edge, or inside the pill.

minimal_style.label: Minimal style
minimal_style.description: Text-only scratchpad labels without colored disc backgrounds.

highlight_focused_monitor_only.label: Highlight focused monitor only
highlight_focused_monitor_only.description: Only use the shown color when the scratchpad is shown on the monitor that has keyboard focus.

shown_color.label: Shown color
shown_color.description: Color role for shown scratchpads; fixed hex colors are also supported.

hidden_color.label: Hidden color
hidden_color.description: Color role for hidden scratchpads that hold windows; fixed hex colors are also supported.

empty_color.label: Empty color
empty_color.description: Color role for empty known scratchpads; fixed hex colors are also supported.

urgent_outline.label: Outline urgent icons
urgent_outline.description: Draw a box in the urgent color around icons of windows that request attention. Many apps do this right after launching.

urgent_color.label: Urgent color
urgent_color.description: Color role for scratchpads with an urgent window; fixed hex colors are also supported.
